description: A BGP neighbour of the router, or the neighbours on a set of interfaces: where to reach them, their AS, and what the router accepts from them and sends them in each address family.

address.description: Unicast address of the neighbour; excludes `interface` and `interfaces`.

bfd.description: Whether the router checks the session's link with BFD, at the timers of the BGP document, and ends the session when BFD finds it down.

description.description: What the neighbour is, in up to 80 printable ASCII characters other than `@`, with a single space between two words.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A BGPPeer's description holds 80 characters at most.
x-chalkos-rules.message: the description holds more than 80 characters

extendedNextHop.description: Whether the router sends and accepts IPv4 routes with IPv6 next hops (RFC 8950). FRR negotiates it on sessions of `interface` and `interfaces` whatever this says.

families.description: The address families the session exchanges routes of, and how.

defaultOriginate.description: Whether the router sends the peer a default route of the family, whatever its own table holds.

export.description: RoutingPolicy that decides the routes the router sends the peer; null sends every route the router has.

import.description: RoutingPolicy that decides the routes the router accepts from the peer; null accepts every route.

maxPrefix.description: Routes the router accepts from the peer at most; past them it ends the session. null sets no limit.

ipv4.description: IPv4 routes of the session; null exchanges none.

interfaces.description: Interfaces, by name or glob, a glob being a prefix followed by `*`, with a session each, as for `interface`; a glob stands for the interfaces of the peer's VRF that the node's Network documents name in a `[Match]` section's `Name=`. Excludes `address` and `interface`.

password.description: Key of a Secret that holds the session's TCP MD5 password, of 80 characters at most and no white space; null for none. The Secret's name and key hold letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` alone.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A BGPPeer's password names its Secret and key as credentials' names.

remoteAS.description: AS of the neighbour: a number, `external` for any AS but the router's, or `internal` for the router's own.

shutdown.description: Whether the router keeps the session down while the document stays.

vrf.description: VRF document whose BGP instance runs the session; null for the default VRF. The peer's interfaces are links of that VRF.
